turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi there. I was thinking of purchasing something for my husband's birthday, but I wanted to know first if I could cancel the subscription afterwards if I don't like it and, if so, how I would do that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure thing, let me pull up information about that policy for you.

turns.speaker: system_action

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your patience. You can cancel your subscription at any time, either by going to your account settings on the website or by contacting a customer service agent.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: When you cancel, you will receive membership benefits until the end of the current month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The current month when you cancel, that is.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: For sure, is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: agent
